The '''Imperial ambassador to Rhamsis Callo''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Ambassador/Legends|official]] assigned to [[Rhamsis Callo]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Feline/Legends|feline]] [[Schenor]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

{{RPG}}
Following an [[Massacre at the Schenor research station|attack]] on a [[Schenor research station]], an important Schenor [[nest-guildmaster]] named [[B'karitz]] came to the Imperial [[Unidentified Imperial base (Rhamsis Callo)|base]] on the world to announce the nullification of the [[Schenor/Imperial treaty]] to the [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] and demand that the Imperials leave. The Imperials pretended to cooperate, but only long enough for a detachment of [[Soldier/Legends|troopers]] to surround and attack B'karitz and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[operative]]s he was with. The besieged group was able to break through the encircling forces and make their way to the Rebels' [[Starship/Legends|ship]], from which B'karitz was able to summon aid from other Schenor [[Noble/Legends|nobles]]. The Imperials attempted to flee, but the Rebels were able to disable and board the ambassador's [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], returning the ambassador to the planet for local judicial action.<ref name="Silent" />
{{Endgame}}
